name: tridevshell
description: A self made cmd made with node.js that offers custom commands to speed up work

scripts.build: pkg dist/bundled-app.js --targets node18-win-x64 --output dist/tridevshell.exe && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if (!fs.existsSync('dist')) { fs.mkdirSync('dist') }; fs.writeFileSync('dist/version.json', JSON.stringify({ version: require('./package.json').version }, null, 2))"
